en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers and a few civilians, including women and children, posing in front of a train at a station. The soldiers wear early 20th‑century military uniforms and caps. Some people stand on the platform while others are in the open train doors. Handwritten Portuguese text appears along the bottom border of the image.
